basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer based in Austin, Texas. I have a keen interest in interdisciplinary education programs, which stems from my own experience double majoring in Computer Science and Philosophy. In my free time, I enjoy exploring local music venues and participating in Austin's vibrant cultural scene. I'm currently single and spend most of my online hours in the evenings after work. I dislike misinformation and appreciate well-researched discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in computer science and philosophy, having studied both at a university level. My expertise in these areas is further supplemented by my professional work as a software engineer. I also have a strong interest in educational programs and often research and discuss them on relevant forums.
